title: Keto Indian Pepper Thali
description: A keto twist on traditional Indian cuisine, featuring a thali-style meal with a variety of flavors and textures.

ingredients.name: nurturing oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral-tasting oil for high heat.

ingredients.name: peppers
ingredients.notes: Any color, but red is recommended for sweetness.

ingredients.name: thali spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of common Indian spices like cumin, coriander, and turmeric.

ingredients.name: keto naan
ingredients.notes: Make your own using almond flour or coconut flour.

ingredients.name: cucumber
ingredients.notes: Sliced for a refreshing side dish.

ingredients.name: tomato
ingredients.notes: Diced for a tangy side dish.

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: Thinly sliced for a sweet side dish.

ingredients.name: chicken breast
ingredients.notes: Cooked to a safe internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).

ingredients.name: keto yogurt
ingredients.notes: Choose a plain, unflavored variety for a keto-friendly side dish.

instructions: Cook the chicken breast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until it reaches a safe internal temperature.
While the chicken cooks, heat the nurturing oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until it's caramelized and golden brown.
Add the diced tomato and sliced cucumber to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the thali spices and cook for 1 minute.
Slice the cooked chicken breast into thin strips and add it to the skillet.
Stir in the keto yogurt and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the thali-style meal with the keto naan on the side.
